headline_seed: Flight delays, flooding and outages grow as storm batters East Coast - The Washington Post
draft_text:
A coastal storm hit the East Coast on Thanksgiving 2026, delaying 1,500+ flights and knocking out power for 800,000+. Business Insider and AeroTime both cite FAA and NWS warnings. TSA expects to screen 3 million travelers Sunday.

And that's the mews.
